citation: Bo S, Broglio F, Settanni F, et al. Effects of meal timing on changes in circulating epinephrine, norepinephrine, and acylated ghrelin concentrations: a pilot study. Nutrition & Diabetes. 2017.
protocol: Cross-over: standard meal (100 g white bread, 100 g ham, 50 g cheese, 125 g yogurt, 200 mL fruit juice; eaten in 25-30 min) at 08:00 and, a week later, at 20:00 (or reverse); the same meal was eaten at home at 24:00 or 12:00 beforehand, then 6 h in bed; indirect calorimetry; blood 0-180 min
population: n=20 healthy volunteers (10 M, 10 F), age 27.6+/-3.4 y, BMI 23.4+/-3.2 (Table 2)
note: Time-of-day contrast for the same meal. Table 3 values look like median (IQR) (labelled so in Methods for non-normal data); epinephrine in ng/L. Pilot-sized analysis.
